description: Measure chroma, (max - min) / max, of the bright pixels of a colour view: every 8th pixel whose mean of R, G and B is above brightness_threshold. Returns JSON: median_chroma, mean_chroma, p25_chroma, p75_chroma, bright_pixel_count. A mono view is an error.

brightness_threshold.description: Mean of R, G and B above which a pixel is measured

name: measure_bright_chroma
